# Tying with Network Effects

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Jay Pil Choi, Doh-Shin Jeon, Michael D. Whinston  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** American Economic Review  
**DOI:** [10.1257/aer.20240461](https://doi.org/10.1257/aer.20240461)

**Keywords:** tying, network effects, bundling, platforms, competition policy

## Abstract

Examines tying strategies in markets with network effects, providing theoretical foundations for understanding bundling and compatibility decisions in digital platforms and technology markets.
